hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Protocol vaults. On each swap, it takes input tokens from the PoolManager, deposits them into an Euler vault, and withdraws output tokens from another vault, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all accounting. Standard liquidity addition and donations are blocked to protect users from unproductive positions.
